summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K disclosing a regular and special distribution of $0.1828 per common share (record April 30, payable May 29, 2026) and a NAV update as of March 31, 2026 ($24.71 per share, $75M aggregate NAV, 1.14x debt/equity). The company also reported $1.8M in private placement subscriptions received April 1, 2026, with ongoing sales at NAV. These are routine operational and regulatory disclosures concerning distributions, NAV, and continuous offerings. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. Filing is a routine current report under Items 7.01 and 8.01. What to watch / risk-arb angle: No actionable special-situation event.
